If those reviews straddle the snapshot timestamp, both are admitted. Reproduction changed validity from the measurement’s `1.0` to the decision helper’s `0.6124`. This can distort candidate acceptance and rollback decisions. Filter using `round_key()` consistently.

**[P2]** **The measured recurrence differs from the detector’s actual signal.** The new measurement counts distinct SHAs, while [detect-recurring-pattern.py:100](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/detect-recurring-pattern.py:100) still deduplicates by round number. Three reviews with different SHAs but the same round number produce measurement recurrence `3`, while the detector reports `1` and recommends a target fix. Policy revisions therefore optimize a different signal from the one that opens mechanism-fix issues. Share the same round-identity logic between both tools.

**[P2]** **A withdrawn recommendation leaves its old policy PR open.** In [revise-improvement-policy.yml:184](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/.github/workflows/revise-improvement-policy.yml:184), an `action: none` run updates only the evidence branch, leaving any existing `improvement-policy-proposal` untouched. New archive entries can legitimately change the decision from `revise` to `none`, as reproduced locally. The old proposal remains available to merge despite no longer satisfying the acceptance rule. Reconcile or close outstanding policy proposals when the current decision no longer supports them.
